senses.sense_definition: część garderoby bez rękawów, noszona na koszuli

examples.text: Elegancki mężczyzna założył do garnituru dopasowaną <w>kamizelkę</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: The elegant man wore a fitted <w>waistcoat</w> with his suit.

examples.text: W chłodny dzień warto założyć pod marynarkę ciepłą <w>kamizelkę</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: On a cold day, it is worth wearing a warm <w>vest</w> under your jacket.

target_lang_definitions.en: A sleeveless garment worn over a shirt, often as part of a suit or for warmth.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: US/Canadian term for a sleeveless garment worn over a shirt, often as part of a suit.
British term for a sleeveless, collarless garment worn over a shirt and under a suit jacket.
